$schema.description: Where this schema lives, so editors can check the file.

summary.description: One line, shown wherever the item is listed.

status.description: draft: still being written. accepted: agreed on, not built yet. implemented: the code does this. deprecated: no longer wanted; kept, with a "deprecation" saying why.

reason.description: Why it is no longer wanted.

replacedBy.description: What takes its place, if anything: requirements ("#RET-7") or items ("uploads/resume").

date.description: When it was deprecated, as YYYY-MM-DD.

deprecation.description: The record of a deprecation. Goes with "status": "deprecated": a requirement or item that is no longer wanted stays in the spec, marked deprecated with the reason, so it stays known that it existed, that it was dropped, and why. It is never deleted, and its id is never used again.

order.description: Position among its siblings, lowest first. Items without one come last, by title.

description.description: What this part does and why.

id.description: Unique in the whole spec, not just in its item, and stable once written: code, tests and other items refer to it by this id alone. A prefix per item ("RET-1", "RET-2") keeps ids apart.

text.description: One statement that can be checked against the code.

level.description: How binding a requirement is. Defaults to must.

reason.description: Why it is no longer wanted.

replacedBy.description: What takes its place, if anything: requirements ("#RET-7") or items ("uploads/resume").

date.description: When it was deprecated, as YYYY-MM-DD.

deprecation.description: The record of a deprecation. Goes with "status": "deprecated": a requirement or item that is no longer wanted stays in the spec, marked deprecated with the reason, so it stays known that it existed, that it was dropped, and why. It is never deleted, and its id is never used again.

src.description: An image in the spec folder, as a path from that folder: "assets/retry-timeline.png".

alt.description: What the image shows, for when it can't be seen.

items.description: A picture: a mockup, a diagram, a screenshot.
Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph, lines starting with "- " form a list, and `backticks` mark code.

code.description: Where this is implemented: paths from the repository's root, or patterns with * and ** ("src/upload/**").

related.description: Ids of other items ("uploads/limits"), or requirements: "#LIM-2" wherever it is, or "uploads/limits#LIM-2".

description: One item of a repository's spec: a .json file in its .spec folder.
